Las obras ejecutadas se acreditarán mediante certificados buena ejecución, indicarán importe, fechas y lugar de ejecución y se precisará si se realizaron según las reglas y se llevaron normalmente a buen término; serán comunicados al órgano de contratación. Cuando se trate de obras ejecutadas por una sociedad extranjera participada por el contratista sin que se cumpla dicha condición, solo se reconocerá como experiencia atribuible al contratista la obra ejecutada por la sociedad participada en la proporción de la participación de aquel en el capital social de esta. El cómputo se efectuará hasta la fecha de finalización del plazo para la presentación de proposiciones u ofertas. Acreditación para empresas de nueva creación en el supuesto del art.88.2 de la LCSP: Podrán acreditar su solvencia técnica mediante una declaración indicando el personal u organismos técnicos, estén integrados o no en la empresa, de los que disponga para la ejecución de las obras. Acreditarse mediante títulos o acreditaciones académicas o profesionales exigidos al personal técnico del empresario, así como el nº de técnicos y experiencia profesional mín exigida a dichos técnicos, o características y capacidades mín de unidades técnicas. Tras la apertura del sobre o archivo electrónico la mesa comprobará en el Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas Clasificadas que la empresa está debidamente constituida, el firmante de la proposición tiene poder bastante para formular la oferta, ostenta la solvencia económica, financiera y técnica o, en su caso la clasificación correspondiente y no está incursa en ninguna prohibición para contratar. Si el licitador hubiera hecho uso de la facultad de acreditar la presentación de la solicitud de inscripción en el correspondiente Registro, la mesa requerirá al licitador para que justifique documentalmente todos los extremos referentes a su aptitud para contratar enunciados en el artículo 159.4.f)

title: Finland – Air-charter services – Charter Flights – Small Business Aircraft 2027
description: This framework agreement covers the provision of charter flights for passengers with small business aircraft. Requirements for the framework agreement are outlined in the Call for Tenders and its appendices, in particular in Annex 1 "Subject-matter". Charter flight services shall fulfill the regulations of the European Union’s mandatory legislation and of mandatory Finnish laws and decrees as well as regulations issued by the Finnish authorities. The usage of the small business aircraft services in the framework agreement of Hansel during a four-year contract period of 2021-2025 was the following: - 103 charter flights with small business aircraft - one (1) ambulance and medical evacuation flight for one (1) patient - 80 % of the departures were from Helsinki-Vantaa Airport, 10 % of the departures were from other airports in Finland and 10 % of the departures were from abroad - destinations were mainly to Europe and Middle East - about 90 % of the flights were round-trip flights and about 10 % of the flights were one way flights. During the period from January 2026 to August 2026, the usage of the services was as follows: - A total of 12 flights were operated - All flights departed from Helsinki-Vantaa Airport - All destinations were located within Europe - Most flights were round trips, while a small number included multiple destinations - The average flight distance was 2,223 nautical miles, ranging from 1,266 to 3,190 nautical miles - The average number of passengers per flight was 9, with passenger loads ranging from 2 to 18. The information above is provided for indicative purposes only and is based on historical service usage. The figures are estimates only and do not constitute a commitment as to future flight volumes, passenger volumes, destinations, or procurement quantities. According to the customers, departures are going to be mainly from Helsinki-Vantaa Airport (EFHK) and Tampere-Pirkkala Airport (EFTP). Possible destinations for the forthcoming contract term are listed in the Annex A "Customers and Destinations". The estimated amount of flights per year for the forthcoming contract term is stated in the Annex A "Customers and Destinations". When taking into account the nature of the service, international circumstances are affecting for the need of the charter flight service. Therefore the actual usage of the framework agreement may differ from the previous framework agreement and the estimations of the customers. The subject of the framework agreement is described in more detail in the Call for Tenders and its annexes. CONTRACT TERM The term of the Agreement is one (1) year and nine (9) months. Hansel has the right to extend the contract term by a maximum of one option period of maximum one (1) year. Hansel will notify of the possible exercise or non-exercise of the option period no later than six (6) months before the end of the Agreement. Services based on the framework agreement can be provided during the term of the Agreement and service contracts. After the expiry, termination, or cancellation of the Agreement, new orders can no longer be made. All charter flights shall be flown within three (3) months period after the expiration of the Agreement. In addition, the contract term for the service contract may exceed three (3) months at the maximum the contract term of the Agreement. The terms and conditions of the Agreement shall be applied to such flights and service contracts even after the expiry of the Agreement. The start date referred to under section "duration" in the contract notice is an estimate of when the agreement will enter into force. THE SCOPE OF THE CALL FOR TENDERS Appendix A "Customers and destinations" of the Call for Tenders indicates the customers who are entitled to use the framework agreement, the possible destinations during the agreement term and the estimated number of flights per year. The estimated value during the contract term is 4 000 000 - 8 000 000 euros (VAT 0 %), including option period. The maximum value is therefore 8 000 000 euros (VAT 0 %). These figures are based on information provided by customers entitled to use the framework agreement and estimates made by Hansel. Framework agreement is covered by the Government Decree on Joint Procurement in Central Government (765/2006) and the Ministry of Finance Decision on Joint Procurement by the Central Government (766/2006). According to these regulations, government agencies and institutions of the state budget economy shall, in principle, use centrally procured contracts.

title: Norway – Repair and maintenance services – Maintenance and further development of ServiceNow
description: Purpose Norsk Tipping (NT) currently uses ServiceNow, among other things, as IT Service Management and CSM tools and currently has a licence and maintenance agreement through DXC Technology. The contract expires in February 2027 and this procurement is a renewal of the maintenance contract for ServiceNow. NT is looking for a professional cooperation partner who can help maintain and further develop the current system. Tenderers must see possibilities, propose improvements and have good routines for development and support. The CSM module is used by Customer Service (Interactions/Case), Dealer service and some other small user groups (Case). Customer service is among norway's best and requires high efficiency in case handling with focus on quick access to information, getting pressure and high system degree. The system bears the mark that it has lived for almost 10 years. There are some technical debts that we need help cleaning up. Part of this is moving some internal APIs, which have been made available with MID-server, over to exposed facade services which are more responsive. The ITSM module is used to a very large degree by IT Operations, but also on customer service, dealer services (incident) and in Security. The case types in use are: incident, major incident, problem, change and request. NP's internal Service Desk and HR use Agent Workspace. ServiceDesk receives cases via the user portal, chat, telephone, attendance and e-mails that are automatically registered in ServiceNow. The case types they work with are primarily incident and request. It is a well developed Change management with a number of automated standard changes. ServiceNow is receiving more and more changes via pipeline or other integrations from internal Jira. The operational centre is the escalation point for general errors in the systems. They have monitoring and use, among other things, Splunk to receive events. Emphasis will be put on the tenderer ́s experience and competence in addition to operation and maintenance. Tenderers shall be a proactive consultant for the entire spectrum of services the contract covers. Whether there is new functionality in ServiceNow, a need for clearing in technical debts, smart choices around integrations, utilisation of functionality in the existing system based on the supplier knowing NP's business needs or the like. Requirements that shall be met. Norsk Tipping has organised development work in a product development model. The Customer Support product area is responsible for i.a. management and further development of ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud and self-service systems. Developers and consultants from the chosen supplier in this procurement will be important resources in this team together with other internal and external resources. NT has few, but good internal resources with competence in ServiceNow, and it is important to have a professional supplier that provides me good access to resources and who can contribute with expert help. As a starting point, the team consists of a system manager/owner and two system administrators, one of whom is defined as a team architect. The product development area currently consists of two multi-disciplinary teams, but which share internal resources and to a large degree work across. The product development manager has management responsibility for the teams and has, in addition, a team management role for the teams, in order to ensure progress and prioritising tasks. The product area is responsible for the management assignments being carried out and together prioritise small and large assignments based on the company principles for product development. description: Notice of Intent to Award / Sole Source The Navajo Area Indian Health Service, Tsaile Health Center intends to award a non-competitive, sole sourced purchase order to ScriptPro USA, Inc., for Compact Robotic Prescription Dispensing System services. The anticipated period of performance is from January 01, 2026 to December 11, 2026 with three one-year option periods. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 339112- Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing with a small business size standard of 1,000 employees. The Proposed Contractor is the only organization uniquely qualified to provide the required services to ensure that there is no interruption in services that could impact direct patient care. The proposed contractor's equipment is currently on-site, fully installed, and is currently being used by Pharmacy staff to provide direct patient care testing services. The ScriptPro system is proficient with RPMS and manages the automated dispensing system workflow. Tsaile Pharmacy Department effectively checks in patient(s) while Pharmacy Techs operate ScriptPro's robotic medication dispensary to match doctor scripts with RPMS system. If the ScriptPro machine support services are down or unavailable, the pharmacy team is not able to support direct patient care services for medication dispensing. Changing out systems would negatively impact direct patient care. This notice of intent to award a sole source contract is not a request for competitive proposals. There will be no solicitation available for competitive quotes. Any response to this notice must show clear and convincing evidence that competition would be advantageous to the Government. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. If no affirmative written response is received by Closing Date/Time, the contract will be issued without further notice. A determination by the Government not to compete the proposed procurement base upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. Any solicitation resulting from the analysis of information obtained will be announced to the public in Federal Business Opportunities. However, responses to this notice will not be considered adequate responses to a solicitation. No proprietary, classified, confidential, or sensitive information should be included in your response. The Government reserves the right to use any non-proprietary technical information in any resultant solicitation(s).

title: Netherlands – Endangered species protection services – Natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) en een gebiedsdekkend (Pré) Soortenmanagementplan (SMP)
description: Gemeente Beekdaelen beoogt met deze aanbestedingsprocedure een gebiedsdekkend soortenmanagementplan (SMP), een pré-SMP en de uitvoering van natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) te verwerven, inclusief begeleiding van de bijbehorende aanvragen omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag. Gemeente Beekdaelen beoogt met deze aanbestedingsprocedure een gebiedsdekkend soortenmanagementplan (SMP), een pré-SMP en de uitvoering van natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) te verwerven, inclusief begeleiding van de bijbehorende aanvragen omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag. De opdracht bestaat uit één overeenkomst voor de ontwikkeling van drie onderdelen. 1. Het uitvoeren van de opdracht Natuurvriendelijk isoleren voor gemeente Beekdaelen; 2. Het ontwikkelen van een Pré-Soortenmangementplan, inclusief het verzorgen en begeleiden van de bijbehorende aanvraagprocedure voor een (tijdelijke) omgevingsvergunning voor een flora- en faunactiviteit bij het bevoegd gezag en ondersteuning bij eventuele bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures voor Gemeente Beekdaelen; 3. Het ontwikkelen van een gebiedsdekkend SMP, inclusief het verzorgen en begeleiden van de bijbehorende aanvraagprocedure voor een gebiedsgerichte omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna-activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag en ondersteuning bij eventuele bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures voor de gemeente Beekdaelen. Beekdaelen telt ongeveer 35.903 inwoners met ongeveer 16.915 woningen. Hiervan zijn 72,8% koopwoningen. Gemeente Beekdaelen heeft een totale oppervlakte van 7.840 hectare en de gemiddelde dichtheid van de adressen is 508 adressen per km2. Het onderzoek richt zich op het bebouwde gebied. Dit bedraagt ongeveer 12.6 km². Het onderzoeksgebied dient als basis voor de prijsvorming. Het definitieve onderzoeksgebied zal in samenspraak met de Provincie Limburg moeten worden vastgesteld gedurende de eerste fase van de opdracht. description: Das Gewässerschutzgesetz verpflichtet die Betreiber öffentlicher Abwasseranlagen zur regelmässigen Zustandskontrolle des Kanalnetzes. Die ERZ Entwässerung der Stadt Zürich führt diese Inspektionen im gesamten Stadtgebiet durch und unter-sucht Kanäle mit Rohrdurchmessern von DN 80 bis DN 3000. Die Zustandsaufnahmen dienen der Werterhaltung der Infrastruktur, der Sicherstellung der Betriebssicherheit sowie dem Schutz von Gewässern und Umwelt. Für die Durchführung dieser Arbeiten werden spezialisierte Kanalinspektionsfahrzeuge mit moderner Kamera- und Inspektionstechnik benötigt. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Einsatzflexibilität sowie technische Leistungsfähigkeit sind aufgrund der unterschiedlichen Kanalgrössen und Einsatzbedingungen hoch. Gestützt auf die Klimaschutzziele der Stadt Zürich sowie die Fahrzeugpolitik der Stadt muss die Fahrzeugflotte bis spätestens 2035 mit wenigen unvermeidbaren Ausnahmen auf erneuerbare Antriebssysteme umgestellt werden. Im Rahmen dieser Zielsetzungen ist für die Ersatz- beziehungsweise Neubeschaffung zwingend ein vollelektrisch betriebenes Fahrzeug vorzusehen. Mit der Beschaffung soll sichergestellt werden, dass die gesetzlichen Inspektionsaufgaben weiterhin zuverlässig, wirtschaftlich und umweltgerecht erfüllt werden können. Gleichzeitig leistet das Fahrzeug einen Beitrag zur Reduktion von CO 2 Emissionen, Lärmemissionen und Umweltbelastungspunkten (UBP) im Sinne der städtischen Netto-Null-Strategie. Das zu liefernde neue Trägerfahrzeug muss zwingend ein Elektrofahrzeug sein und soll ein maximales Gesamtgewicht von 7.5t aufweisen und mit einem Auf- / Ausbau ausgestattet werden. Der Auf- /Ausbau des Trägerfahrzeugs beinhaltet zudem einen Bedienraum für eine Person (Einstieg seitlich, in Fahrtrichtung rechts) sowie einen Heckraum, in welchem die TV Anlage, sowie die dazu benötigten Geräte und Werkzeuge untergebracht sind. Das Inspektionssystem muss für Hauptkanal und Hausanschluss und Schächten ausgelegt sein. DN 80 bis DN 3500 sind möglich zu Inspizieren. Die TV Anlage / Aufbau muss so ausgelegt sein, dass die TV Anlage / Aufbau die elektrische Energie des Fahrzeugs bezieht und durch die elektrische Energie des Fahrzeugs vollständig betrieben wird. Weitere Details zum Liefergegenstand sind dem Dokument D1 Leistungsverzeichnis zu entnehmen. Der Anbieter offeriert zudem die Wartung des Liefergegenstands gemäss den Formblättern D2.1- D2.2.

Kompleksowa realizacja przedmiotu zamówienia obejmuje również wszelkie prace pomocnicze i towarzyszące, które są konieczne do prawidłowego wykonania robót, tj. organizacja i zabezpieczenie placu budowy oraz wszelkie prace przygotowawcze i porządkowe wraz z uporządkowaniem terenu po zakończeniu budowy i opracowaniem dokumentacji powykonawczej po zrealizowaniu robót budowlanych. Łączna długość przewodów wodociągowych przewidzianych do modernizacji wynosi około 0,35 km. Zakres prac obejmuje modernizację w ul. Chełmickiej (od ul. Lipnowskiej do Ujęcia Wody/ SUW "Zawiśle") istniejącej sieci wodociągowej magistralnej wraz z przebudową, wymianą i montażem armatury i węzłów wodociągowych. Przewody i zasuwy wytypowane do modernizacji i wymiany zlokalizowane są głównie w pasach drogowych. Zakłada się przeprowadzenie renowacji magistrali metodą bezwykopową w technologii luźnego pasowania wraz z koniecznymi punkowymi wykopami montażowymi celem wykonania węzłów zasuw, połączenia i przełączenia przewodów, itp. Powyższe zamówienie będzie realizowane w rozumieniu ustawy z dnia 7 lipca 1994 – Prawo budowlane, jako zaprojektowanie i wykonanie robót budowlanych zgodnie z opracowanym Programem Funkcjonalno-Użytkowym (PFU), stanowiącym Tom III Specyfikacji Warunków Zamówienia (SWZ) w/w przetargu. W ramach niniejszego Zamówienia Wykonawca opracuje m.in. dokumentację projektową do zgłoszenia robót lub pozwolenie na budowę (o ile będzie wymagana) oraz dokumentację techniczną wykonawczą niezbędną do wykonania i ukończenia robót modernizacyjnych na podstawie wytycznych PFU. Wykonawca zobowiązany będzie również uzyskać wszelkie niezbędne pozwolenia, opinie, uzgodnienia i zatwierdzenia, itp., wynikające z wykonywanej dokumentacji i prowadzonych robót oraz przepisów prawa obowiązującego w tym zakresie. Przedmiotowe zamówienie jest częścią Projektu pn. „Modernizacja systemu zaopatrzenia w wodę do spożycia na terenie miasta Włocławek” w ramach programu Fundusze Europejskie na Infrastrukturę, Klimat, Środowisko 2021-2027, priorytet FENX.02 Wsparcie sektorów energetyka i środowisko, działanie FENX.02.05 Woda do spożycia. Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia określa Specyfikacja Warunków Zamówienia (SWZ), w tym Tom II (Wzór umowy), Tom III (Opis Przedmiotu Zamówienia – Program Funkcjonalno-Użytkowy) oraz Tom IV (Tabela cen).

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – FE 05.0217/2026/FGB - „Alternative Bindemittel zur Bodenbehandlung im Erdbau des Straßenbaus“
description: Die normierten Bindemittel Kalk und Zement werden wirksam zur Bodenbehandlung eingesetzt. Der Nachteil jedoch ist, dass Kalke und Zemente eine hohe CO2-Emission verursachen. Es soll daher erkundet werden, welche alternativen Bindemittel zur nachhaltigen Bodenbehandlung verwendet werden können. Bei dem genormten Bindemittel Zement besteht die Bestrebung, durch klinkerreduzierte Zemente eine bessere CO2-Bilanz zu erreichen. Die Reduktion der Klinkerphasen bedeutet aber auch eine Reduktion der festigkeitsbildenden Komponenten. Insofern wäre durch Eignungsprüfungen zu untersuchen, ob die klinkerreduzierten Zemente für die Bodenbehandlung verwendbar sind. Die Zugabe von Asche (z.B. Papierasche, Flugasche) bewirkt im Boden eine Veränderung der Verdichtungseigenschaft als auch eine Festigkeitsbildung. Bei Aschen stellen sich neben den Fragen nach der Wirkungsweise aber außerdem Fragen nach der gleichbleibenden und verlässlichen Zusammensetzung (Schwankungsbreite der Zusammensetzung) sowie nach den umweltrelevanten Inhaltstoffen. Es gibt Sonderbindemittel auf dem Markt, die als Bindemittel oder als Additive verwendet werden. Bodenbehandlungsadditive dienen der Verbesserung der Materialeigenschaften des Ausgangsmaterials und der Reduktion der anschließend zuzugebenden Bindemittelmenge. Das Ziel der Forschungsarbeit ist es, die Wirkungsweise ausgewählter alternativer Bindemittel zu untersuchen und mit der Wirkungsweise genormter Bindemittel zu vergleichen. Des Weiteren soll eine Grundsatzprüfung für alternative Bindemittel sowie eine Eignungsprüfung für Bodenbehandlungen mit nicht genormten Bindemitteln erarbeitet werden. Es liegt im Inte-resse des Bundes, einen nachhaltigen Straßenbau zu betreiben, was sowohl bedeutet, dass Bindemittel verwendet werden, die den Boden wirksam verbessern oder dauerhaft verfestigen als auch umweltverträglich, emissionsarm, ressourcenschonend und ökonomisch sind.

Gebäude und Technik sind weitgehend veraltet und weisen erheblichen Sanierungsbedarf auf. Das überarbeitete Konzept sieht eine Erweiterung um rund 45 m² vor. Geplant sind ein separater Eingang, Barfußgang, Duschen sowie barrierefreie Umkleide-, WC- und Duschbereiche. Das bestehende Fliesenbecken soll durch Fugensanierung erhalten bleiben und zusätzlich mit einem Poollift barrierefrei erschlossen werden. Erneuert bzw. saniert werden Schwimmbad-, Lüftungs- und Gebäudetechnik, Beleuchtung, Fenster, Heizkörper und Flachdach. Eine Wärmepumpe, Photovoltaikanlage und LED-Beleuchtung sollen Energie sparen und den Strombedarf des Schwimmbads um rund 20 % senken. Die Fertigstellung ist bis 31.03.2028 vorgesehen. Während der Bauphase bleibt das Bad geschlossen.

title: Norway – Repair and maintenance services of building installations – Painting and covering services
description: Background Tønsberg municipality needs to establish a new framework agreement for painting and covering services as the existing contract has expired and must be replaced. The procurement shall ensure that the municipality still has access to the necessary services for ongoing maintenance and planned upgrades in the municipality's buildings and sites. The municipality has a continual and increasing need for external and internal surface treatment in, among other things, schools, nurseries, health buildings and other purpose-built buildings. The objective of the procurement is to ensure the right quality, predictable delivery and effective follow-up of assignments across entities. The framework agreement shall contribute to good use of resources, clear call-off routines and stable delivery ability throughout the entire contract period. The aim is to have a parallel model with two tenderers, where assignments are generally offered to the tenderer ranked as number one and thereafter the tenderer ranked second if the first tenderer is unable to deliver within the set deadlines. The estimated total value is approx. NOK 35,000,000 excluding VAT over four years. Description of the assignment The procurement is for a framework agreement for the delivery of painting and covering services for Tønsberg municipality. The delivery shall cover the municipality ́s need for work connected to paint, floor coverings and other surface treatment, both indoor and outdoor. The framework agreement shall cover ongoing maintenance, minor repairs and planned redecorating works in municipal buildings and sites. The assignments can vary in size and complexity and will i.a. apply to work in schools, nurseries, health buildings and other buildings in daily use. Emphasis will be put on call-offs under the framework agreement being made efficient and predictable, with a quick response, good coordination with the municipality ́s units and equal quality in the deliveries, regardless of which tenderer carries out the assignment. The delivery shall also support the need for good documentation, including status reports and assignment related documentation. The work shall be able to be carried out in a way that ensures safe operation and limits disadvantages for users of the buildings. This is particularly important in buildings with vulnerable user groups and high activity, such as schools, nurseries and health buildings.

title: Norway – Pest-control services – Pest control and control - Framework agreement
description: Background Tønsberg municipality has a continual need for services and materials connected to control, prevention and control of pests in the municipality ́s buildings and associated facilities. The existing agreement expires and the municipality needs to establish a new framework agreement that ensures continued safe, efficient and predictable follow-up in the agreement period. The aim of the procurement is to cover the municipality ́s need for both planned and emergency services within pest control, at the same time that the municipality receives a combined and transparent agreement for the area. The framework agreement shall contribute to early pest detection, reduce the risk of consequential damage, strengthen health, environment and safety and facilitate equal practice and quality across the municipality ́s buildings and sites. The municipality emphasises a long-term cooperation with a tenderer who can offer professional advice, good documentation and close follow-up of the assignments. It is also important that the delivery supports the municipality ́s goal of efficient use of resources, good contract follow-up, as well as climate and environmental considerations in the implementation of the services. Description of the assignment The procurement is for a framework agreement with one tenderer for the delivery of services and accompanying material for the control and control of pests. The contract shall include both preventive work, periodic inspections and acute call-outs as needed. The delivery shall cover the municipality ́s need for municipal buildings as well as relevant outside areas and technical infrastructure, including, among other things, roads, water and sewage. The assignment includes pest control both indoor and outdoor, including pest management in kitchen areas and other vulnerable locations. The service shall mainly cover inspections, assessment of scope and reason, implementation of the necessary measures, use and delivery of necessary material such as traps and baiting stations, as well as written reporting for each assignment. The tenderer shall also be able to make recommendations on preventive measures and contribute to a better overview, traceability and history per building or facility. The assignment can include pest control, including rats, mice, wall animals, cockroaches, silverfish and beards, ants, moths and other relevant insects. The extent in the contract period can vary, and the stated volume is only an estimate based on previous consumption. The delivery shall therefore be scaleable and adapted to the municipality ́s actual need throughout the contract period.

W przypadku podziału zamówienia na części i niepowodzenia jednej z nich, zamawiającemu groziłaby utrata finansowania na całe zamówienie. Przedmiot zamówienia stanowi jednolitą całość pod względem technicznym, technologicznym, jakościowym i organizacyjnym. 9.Termin związania ofertą upływa dnia 16 lutego 2027r.
